scope: Post-hoc descriptive analysis of existing benchmark-corrected only; no candidate, timing rerun, navigation execution or causal claim
warmup: Retain and validate repeat -1 separately; not performance samples
delta: after minus before; positive is slower
concentration: Top 1/5/10 positive paired wall differences divided by sum of ALL positive differences, not signed net. No samples excluded.
preserve: Do not alter old rejection, source, safety, thresholds, old artifacts or failures
